meta.triageRationale: bugfix (small): one module (src/db/entities.ts, src/db/lance/entity-vec.ts), clear approach, no new contract.

body.focus: Implement ISSUE-8c7d75b08e02a7a8 (keep one vector row per entity id): (a) before the plain add of first-allocated entities' vectors in writeVectorsThenMarkers, delete any rows stored for those ids (a failure leaves markers empty for the backfill); (b) reconcileEntityVectors also finds ids with more than one vector row, deletes all their rows and clears the marker so the backfill writes one, reporting duplicateIdsRepaired; (c) writeBackfillVectors deletes a vector it wrote for an entity no longer stored; (d) commitFile logs, not throws, a failed removal-vector delete after the graph commit.
body.summary: The entity vector table keeps one row per id: the plain add deletes any existing rows for first-allocated ids first, the start-time reconciliation repairs ids stored twice (reported as duplicateIdsRepaired), vectors written for entities removed meanwhile are deleted, and a failed removal-vector delete no longer fails a committed change. Four tests in src/db/__tests__/vector-one-row-per-id.test.ts reproduce each path; each fix part was mutation-checked.
